about.label: 02 / About
about.pullQuote: Civil engineer who crossed into software.
about.bio:
I spent years building highway infrastructure — road asset management, construction supervision, maintenance coordination. Then I started automating the paperwork with VBA, then building the tools the industry actually needed.

Today I have four systems in active development or production: a dental commerce platform processing 300+ daily purchases through a physical payment terminal; a WebXR optical store with 3D try-on and multi-location POS; a 3D construction monitoring platform with native iOS and Android apps for on-site capture; and a macOS utility distributed outside the App Store. Web, WebXR, iOS, Android, macOS — built from scratch, not assembled from templates.

The civil engineering background is not incidental. It is why I build software that works in the physical world.

deltavis.title: DeltaVis
deltavis.oneliner: 3D construction monitoring platform for civil engineers.
deltavis.description: Load two 3D scans of the same construction site at different dates, align them mathematically using the Kabsch algorithm — Jacobi SVD implemented from scratch, no linear algebra library — measure volumetric differences, and export a professional PDF report. Native iOS and Android apps let engineers capture directly on site. Built for the workflows civil engineers and drone operators actually use.

insumos.title: InsumosDentales Chiapas
insumos.oneliner: A dental supply business runs on this — 300+ daily purchases, 100+ through a physical terminal. In production today.
insumos.description: Live in production: 100+ registered users, 300+ daily purchases through the POS, over 100 processed through the MercadoPago Point Smart 2 terminal. Dual-channel system: online store with MercadoPago Checkout Pro and a full physical POS. FCM push notifications, loyalty rewards with race condition-safe Firestore transactions, multi-role access, and a complete order fulfillment workflow.

opticas.title: Ópticas Valverde
opticas.oneliner: Optical store ecommerce with 3D glasses try-on and multi-location POS.
opticas.description: Customers browse glasses with real-time 3D models, try them on virtually via WebXR, or step into a virtual booth with up to three frames loaded side by side. Behind the counter: a POS across multiple locations with shared inventory management, and client records including uploaded medical prescriptions. Apple Pay through Stripe. Apple Sign-In through Firebase.

screenboundary.title: ScreenBoundary
screenboundary.oneliner: macOS utility that turns regions of one physical monitor into real, independent virtual displays.
screenboundary.description: Two use cases, one binary: rescue a cracked monitor by drawing zones over intact glass — each becomes its own display with its own menu bar, Spaces, and native fullscreen. Or split a 34–49″ ultrawide into 2–3 real displays. Built on a private macOS API (CGVirtualDisplay). Signed with Developer ID, notarized, built-in auto-revert failsafe. No account, no analytics.
